prompts: Use case: scientific-educational. Generate a high-resolution TRANSPARENT PNG equation asset, wide landscape 3:1, tightly composed with generous but not excessive outer padding. Original clean modern mathematical typesetting for a Korean high school chemistry slide, no textbook page, no scanned texture, no borders, no cards, no headings, no watermark. Black lettering, green (#57962F) simple row labels A B C on the left. Exactly three horizontal rows, perfectly identical font size in every row; equations on the left, enthalpy on the right. All text crisp regular sans-serif approximating Pretendard. Chemistry elements and parentheses upright, only state letters s g l italic; mathematical H after Δ visibly italic. Proper chemical subscripts and ΔH subscripts 1,2,3. Render these exact three rows, preserve signs and values: A   C(s, 흑연) + 2H₂(g) → CH₄(g)     ΔH₁ = −74.8 kJ ; B   C(s, 흑연) + O₂(g) → CO₂(g)     ΔH₂ = −393.5 kJ ; C   H₂(g) + ½O₂(g) → H₂O(l)     ΔH₃ = −285.8 kJ . Here semicolons separate rows and must NOT be printed. Use compact consistent row gaps. No surrounding content. True transparent alpha.

Use case scientific-educational. Create a completely new clean math typesetting PNG asset with true transparent background, landscape 2.5:1. Not a textbook reproduction. No boxes, no scanned paper, no decoration. Black regular sans-serif lettering approximating Pretendard, crisp identical size throughout ALL equations, mathematical H after Δ italic, chemical elements upright, state letters g/l/s italic inside upright parentheses, chemical subscripts correct. Compact four-row layout. Left-aligned equations, green #57962F only for the short label at start of row 3. Exact content rows: row1: ΔH = (ΔH₂ + 2ΔH₃) − ΔH₁ . row2: = (−393.5) + 2 × (−285.8) − (−74.8) = −890.3 kJ . row3: B + 2C − A . row4: CH₄(g) + 2O₂(g) → CO₂(g) + 2H₂O(l) . Do not print periods at ends of rows. Ensure minus before negative74.8 preserved. No extra title, numbers, formulas, units or characters. Original arrangement with the first two rows grouped tightly, then a slightly larger gap before row3 and row4 grouped tightly. Transparent alpha.
